name: Secretaría Distrital de Planeación
body: A meta description on every page analyzed, framing limited to its origin, nosniff, and every link opened answered. But the plain-http home page answers 200 with no redirect, and no HSTS is sent.
lesson: Redirect every http request to https with a 301, then add Strict-Transport-Security.
summary: www.sdp.gov.co scores 64 out of 100 (D). 4 checks fail now, 28 are at risk, and 12 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: Plain http serves the site without redirecting
fix.evidence: http:// answered 200. Visitors who type the address stay unencrypted.
fix.fix: Redirect every http request to https with a 301, then add HSTS.

fix.title: Analytics may count some visits twice
fix.evidence: 20 pages load gtag.js more than once.
fix.fix: Keep one GA4 property per site and load gtag.js once, or manage it only inside Tag Manager.

fix.title: 2 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /transparencia. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: The start page does not declare its language
fix.evidence: Screen readers pick the wrong voice and browsers offer the wrong translation.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Every page has a meta description
The start page sets a mobile viewport
